External services

Third-party services

Last updated: October 4, 2026

Versa Player may interact with external services only when the corresponding feature is available and used.

Google Play

May be involved in app distribution, Versa Premium purchase and restoration, and purchase-state verification.

Google Mobile Ads (AdMob)

May display native advertising in the free edition when the relevant configuration and privacy choices allow it.

Google User Messaging Platform (UMP)

May present and manage advertising-related privacy and consent choices where applicable.

Internet radio

Versa Player may query a station directory and connect directly to the server of the station selected by the user. Stations and their content are independent of Versa Player.

Device voice services

Speech recognition and synthesis may depend on the service configured in Android and on that provider's policies.

Manual web search

For lyrics or artwork, Versa Player may open a browser or web search at the user's explicit request. Versa Player does not automatically extract content from those pages. The browser and search provider may process the search query under their own policies.

Listing a service here does not imply ownership, affiliation, sponsorship or endorsement by that provider unless expressly stated.
